PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_BackdraftDamper
PropertySetDef.Definition:
Definition from IAI: This property set is used to define the characteristics of a backdraft damper.
HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 2.0.
ISSUES: No issues to date.

PropertyDef.Name: FrameType
PropertyDef.Definition: The type of frame used by the damper (e.g., Standard, Single Flange, Single Reversed Flange, Double Flange, etc.)
